conventions.ingredient_count_band: Counted ingredients exclude optional items, salt, black pepper, water, and cooking oils (neutral oil): <=8 -> 0, 9-14 -> 1, 15+ -> 2.
conventions.pantry_familiarity: Kept 0; specialty items scored once under specialty_burden. Cultural unfamiliarity adds no points.
